_doc: Sabah/Kota Kinabalu (Malaysia) journeys removed from gojek eastern-indonesia split; park for a future Borneo/Sabah market. Do NOT seal into an Indonesia geo.

journeys.today: The day-trip out to Mantanani's white-sand snorkel islands is a long, bouncy speedboat slog across open Sabah water.
journeys.with_navier: A near-silent Pioneer II foiling run carries day-trippers from Kota Kinabalu out to Mantanani above the chop, booked in the Gojek app.

journeys.today: Resort guests shuttle from Sutera Harbour to Gaya Island on a diesel tender that throws spray and noise across the bay.
journeys.with_navier: A short, smooth Pioneer II hop glides guests from Sutera Harbour to the Gaya Island resorts with almost no wake, booked in Gojek.

journeys.to: Tunku Abdul Rahman park (Gaya / Manukan / Sapi)
journeys.today: The crossing from Jesselton Point to the Gaya/Manukan/Sapi park islands is a crowded diesel speedboat that churns the marine-park water it crosses.
journeys.with_navier: A clean low-wake Pioneer II hop carries park-goers from Jesselton Point out to Manukan and Sapi, booked in the Gojek app.
